limitations: Desktop presentation scope; no mobile acceptance claim.
Whole-company Fit is an overview; focused workspaces/maps are the readable presentation views.
Plaintext synthetic SQLite storage, local password accounts, no deployed Supabase/SSO or production connectors.
Company containment disables one fixed local restart route; it does not repair source code, isolate a host or change production routing.
The prebuilt protected restart path is independently checked; no model can approve or execute infrastructure changes.
Normal product chat uses authenticated local server streams, separate from the retained encrypted three-peer protocol on one Mac. No physical radio-mesh claim.
With excessive HTTP/1 tabs, requests may wait for ten-second stream renewal; permanent starvation was addressed, not unlimited-tab performance.
Model/SSH/internet availability is not guaranteed. Backup remains visibly labeled. Analysis, brief and import preview caches are memory-only and scope/revision changes invalidate them.
Final browser round did not upload a company import or repeat employee deletion/connection deletion. Earlier browser passes and existing import/HTTP checks supply the narrower evidence.
After-hours coverage is a manual eligibility check, without deployed pager, SMS/email/push delivery or autonomous escalation daemon.

research.supports: HTTP/1 same-origin SSE browser connection limit; informed bounded stream renewal.
